G01.notes: Three goals connect a chosen controlled comparison, within-station loss/rate calculation and leaf phase/pathway interpretation to distinct original explanations.

G02.notes: Two separate matched model balances and one synchronized30-minute interval answer one student-selected factor. No three identical extractions/trials or claim of independent population samples. Different pot/cover starting masses require subtraction.

G03.notes: OpenStax30.5, UMN, Nebraska, SAPS and actual Forest Research scanned pages checked for mesophyll evaporation, stomatal/boundary vapor transport, sealed-pot mass loss versus uptake and conditional light/wind/humidity effects. Toy conductance settings are assumptions, not fitted measurements.

G04.notes: Fixed25°C, leaf area, adequate water, synthetic mass/rate values, constant aperture/settings, one model interval and omitted real mass changes/stress are explicit. Brighter light does not warm the model leaf; no universal field prediction or physical protocol.

G05.notes: Students cover soil/pot, move the covered plant to its own pan, install their chosen off-pan controller, read four displays, calculate loss/rates and place process annotations that reveal the leaf pathway.

G06.notes: Actual station initial/covered/on-pan/final states, changed humidity module and leaf before/after/light/humidity/phone/tablet reviewed. Separate review clarified film across the soil around the stem; leaves remain exposed, pot rests on pan and controller stays outside it. Hollow vapor symbols traverse the actual open pore.

G07.notes: Chosen factor locks with the first plan; seeded annotation/check choices avoid fixed-order answers. Both higher and lower changed rates tested; conclusion uses actual rounded recorded values rather than final-mass ranking.

G08.notes: Full directions, dynamic labels/feedback, reports and handouts read. Transpiration, xylem, mesophyll, evaporation, diffusion, rate and relative humidity explained.
